tasks.label: vtouch: 推送 SDK 与脚本到手机
vtouch: 运行 SDK 自测
tasks.command: adb shell 'rm -f /sdcard/vtouch-sdk-test-result.txt; am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d file:///sdcard/vtouch_sdk_test.js -t application/x-javascript -n org.autojs.autojs6/org.autojs.autojs.external.open.RunIntentActivity'

tasks.label: vtouch: 运行最小示例
tasks.command: adb shell 'am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d file:///sdcard/vtouch_plugin_example.js -t application/x-javascript -n org.autojs.autojs6/org.autojs.autojs.external.open.RunIntentActivity'

tasks.label: vtouch: 查后端状态
tasks.command: adb shell 'su -c "ps -A | grep vtouchd | grep -v grep || echo NO_PROC; cat /data/local/tmp/vtouch-runtime/vtouchd.log 2>/dev/null | tail -3"'
